style: Avant-garde art-rock and theatrical avant-folk. Harmony: polyharmonic suspension fields with quartal voicings and unresolved upper partials, generating permanent tonal instability. Melody: clipped consonant runs with alveolar trills, front-rounded vowel shifts, and phrase-level prominence peaks. Rhythm: 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling with double-time hallucination, asymmetric metric collisions, and micro-timed stutter delays. Timbre: magnetic tape loops, optigan pads, talk box, vocoder, physical-modeling strings, and granular swarms. Performance: breathless hype delivery paired with deep bewilderment headspace and manic micro-gestures. Production: dry separation stemminess with cheap analog tape saturation, spring recoil, and harsh exposure windows that expose every breath. Spatialization: hyper-dry close-mic mono sources competing with sprawling binaural hallucinations across the stereo field, utilizing phase cancellation to simulate sudden cognitive vacuum and ontological destabilization
